completion_rule: An operation becomes COMPLETE only when its CoreSpec law, program encoding, bounded verification, reference evaluation, VM, AOT, source producer, differential evidence, and old-owner deletion are all complete in one vertical slice.

core_spec_stage.note: Operation rows remain frozen rather than globally COMPLETE until W2-W7 consumers and old-owner deletion are complete.

program_format_stage.note: W2 owns canonical bytes and bounded structural decode. W3 owns typed admission; executor coverage remains frozen for W5-W7.

semantic_admission_stage.note: All 15 active walking-skeleton operations have bounded verification and independent reference evaluation. Inactive ownership, coroutine, import, boundary, and AOT surfaces fail closed until their owning slices activate them.

vm_stage.note: All 15 walking-skeleton operations execute in the independent typed VM and match the reference evaluator. Private fixed rows are disposable runtime views, not a second public bytecode or distribution format.

aot_stage.native_identity: ExecutionId + BackendId + ToolchainId + OptimizationPolicyId + native bytes
aot_stage.note: All 15 walking-skeleton operations lower through an independently verified BackendIR into portable C11. The pure native fixture links no VM, compiler, program loader, or AOT toolchain.

operations.program_encoding: typed result value plus canonical signed LEB128 payload
operations.decoder_verifier_evaluator: bounded LEB128 decode, result-type check, direct constant evaluation
operations.vm_implementation: typed i64 slot or private specialization derived from the verified operation
operations.aot_lowering: XrBackendIR i64 constant, then exact-width generated C literal
operations.source_producer: integer literal and canonical constant folding
operations.old_owner_deletion: delete duplicate VM constant decoding and AOT literal semantic inference in W7-scalar
